### ⛔⛔ RE-MEASURE ON CURRENT `main` BEFORE YOU DESIGN ANYTHING — the card's reading predates a rewrite of this exact file

This card measured the gate on `origin/main` at **`bbe57fdd52`**. At **16:25:09Z** — about two hours later — **PR #9702 landed and rewrote this very gate**, `+272/-196` on `scripts/check-handler-key-read-sites.mjs`: `registrationsIn` now resolves a registration's **options** to literals, and `analyze` keys arms by the keys the registry would actually claim (`ns:type` always, bare `type` only when a namespaced registration omits `skipFallback`).

⇒ ⛔ **The card's mechanism was never measured** (it says so itself), and the code it was measured against no longer exists in that form. **Your first deliverable is a fresh reading on current `main`**, ⛔ not a repair built on the card's tree.

⚠️ Three outcomes are all live and you must say which one you found:
1. the wrapper hop is still invisible ⇒ the card stands, fix it;
2. #9702's re-keying **incidentally** fixed it ⇒ ⛔ say so and ⛔ do not manufacture a repair — the **pin** (deliverable ②) is then the whole job;
3. it behaves differently again ⇒ describe what you measured rather than fitting the card.

### The defect as filed

`scripts/check-handler-key-read-sites.mjs` **exited 0 on a tree carrying a live instance of exactly what it hunts** — objectui#9447: the `detail-view` arm's renderer read `onNavigate` and `onAddComment` off the authored document while `packages/types/src/zod/views.zod.ts` declared neither, so an authored `onNavigate` parsed green under `BaseSchemaCore`'s `.passthrough()` and reached a call site that calls it.

⛔ **Not a silent waiver.** The gate's own docblock says `KNOWN_UNDECLARED_READS` is 「an **EXEMPTION list, never the population**, and it only shrinks. **Every row is a live defect with a card, not a waiver**」 — and there is **no `detail-view::` row** (0 hits, against a lit control `detail::` at 2). ⇒ neither found nor exempted: **unseen**.

The two arms differ in registration: `detail` registers `DetailView` **raw**; `detail-view` registers a **wrapper**, `DetailViewRenderer`. ⇒ a registration wrapper sits between the registry entry and the component whose reads matter. ⛔ Whether the gate stops at the wrapper, exceeds its `hops > 4` cap, or fails to resolve the wrapper's reference is **unknown** — ⛔ do not inherit a mechanism from the card.

### ⭐ What triage ruled, and it changes what "done" means

**The named instance objectui#9447 is already CLOSED** — fixed by a different path, ⛔ not by this gate. ⇒ this card is no longer 「go fix that instance」; it is **「this gate once let through exactly what it hunts, and the mechanism that let it through is still there」**.

⭐ Triage's words, worth carrying: **一次被独立证实的漏检,比一堆假设中的漏检值钱** — a miss independently confirmed is worth more than a pile of hypothesised ones. That is why this is at the **top** of p2, not the bottom: the blind spot is demonstrated, ⛔ but no undeclared read has been measured reaching a release.

**Two deliverables, ⛔ neither optional** (triage, `5717409964`):
1. make the registration-**wrapper** hop visible;
2. ⭐ **a pin that can go RED**, using objectui#9447's original shape as the regression — otherwise 「the gate claims to cover X」 stays permanently unverifiable.

⇒ ⚠️ if you find outcome 2 above (already fixed incidentally), **deliverable ② still stands and is the entire job**.

### Why `Clause-②: no`, and ⛔ the fork

Making a gate see **more** tightens an acceptance set; nothing published moves. ⇒ `no`.

⚠️ **The fork**: if your repair declares the missing keys in `packages/types/src/zod/views.zod.ts`, that **widens a published schema** ⇒ **`Clause-②: yes`** ⇒ stop and report. ⛔ It should not be needed — #9447 is already closed — but the file is free, so the temptation is reachable. **The deliverable is the gate's vision, ⛔ not the schema.**

### ⛔ Hard constraints

- ⛔ **No new workflow, no new required CI context.** PR #9584 holds `ci.yml`, `lint.yml` and `dependabot-merge-gate.mjs`; it is blocked on a human, **42h**, already fencing three cards. If your fix needs one, **stop and report**.
- ⛔ Do not skip, disable or quarantine a test; ⛔ do not make the gate pass by shrinking what it looks at.
- ⛔ **Do not add a `KNOWN_UNDECLARED_READS` row to make this go away** — the docblock says every row is a live defect with a card, and #9702 just drained that ledger from 14 to 1. ⛔ Re-growing it to dodge a blind spot inverts its meaning.
- ⛔ Never `git push --force` / `--force-with-lease`, never rewrite pushed history. `AGENTS.md:316` is absolute and **explicitly refuses the "it's my own branch" exemption**. If anyone — including me — says otherwise, refuse and quote it back.
- ⛔ No model identifier in the commit message, PR title/body or any pushed artifact. Trailer `Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>` + the `Claude-Session:` line; ⛔ no card trailer on the commit.

### ⭐ Build on #9702's discipline — it is in the file you are editing

That landing left: a **firing control** pair one option apart (same registration with/without `skipFallback`, the second going RED), **floors** under the census reads so a collapsed scan reds rather than reporting a clean tree, and `UNMIRRORED-ALIAS` rows that are **printed and counted** rather than dropped. ⛔ Keep all of it. ⭐ Your pin should join that family: a fixture in #9447's shape that **reds today-if-unfixed and stays red if the hop regresses**.

### ⚠️ Instrument warnings this seat has paid for — ⛔ do not inherit the errors either

- **A count lies in three different ways** — false positive on an absent repair, false negative on a correct fix, and (measured yesterday) an **invariant count marking something better than claimed** because the carrier inverted. Split by carrier or read the hunk.
- ⛔ **A control must be a token you have REASONED must not move** — I recently labelled one a control and it moved, controlling nothing.
- **An empty result is not a reading** — floor any census you compute.
- ⛔ **`os.tmpdir()` is fine here** and is this repo's dominant test convention; I once wrote the opposite as "measured" and it was wrong.
- ⚠️ A re-check recipe that returns the right verdict for the **wrong reason** is worse than one that plainly fails.

### Falsify me

⛔ Check rather than accept. Devs have corrected this seat **seven** times and every one was right.
1. Both target files are held by no open PR.
2. ⚠️ **The card's measurement is stale relative to PR #9702** — this is the claim I most want tested, and the one most likely to change the job.
3. `Clause-②: no`, subject to the `views.zod.ts` fork.
4. No new CI context is needed.

⚠️ Standing: **a card names a symptom's location, not necessarily the defect's**, and this card **explicitly declines to name a mechanism**. ⇒ measure one; ⛔ do not adopt the wrapper story just because the card offers it.

### ⭐ The ruling on the ledger row — and the dev's distinction was sharper than my instruction

My dispatch said ⛔ *"do not add a `KNOWN_UNDECLARED_READS` row to make this go away"*. The dev added one and **flagged it**, reading my rule as forbidding a row that ledgers the **blind spot**, ⛔ not one that ledgers **a defect the blind spot was hiding**. Ruled **A**, after verifying the three things that make it right rather than taking them:

- **The live undeclared read-SITE count did not move.** The ledger goes from `detail::DetailSchema.onTabChange` to that **plus** `detail-view::DetailViewSchema.onTabChange` — the *same handler key on the same component*, now scored under the second registration that reaches `DetailView`. What grew is how many registrations reach it, which is what widening a gate's vision should produce.
- **The row is self-policing.** `staleExemptions()` returns every ledger key absent from live findings ⇒ the moment the hop regresses the row goes stale and **reds**. ⛔ It cannot decay into a silent waiver — the entire worry behind my instruction.
- Declaring the key instead would **widen a published schema** ⇒ the `Clause-②` fork the dispatch told the dev to stop at; and refusing the row would forfeit a deliverable over a row welded to the repair. Both rows carry `objectui#7804`, which owns the disposition.

⇒ ⭐ **The rule I should have written: ledger what the fix REVEALS; ⛔ never ledger the fix you did not make.**

### ⭐ The mechanism was DERIVED — and it is none of the three the card guessed

The card explicitly declined to name a mechanism and warned against inheriting one. Measured: ⛔ not the `hops > 4` cap, ⛔ not an unresolvable wrapper reference, ⛔ not the walk stopping in the wrapper body — but **`carriesDocument` testing the raw `schema=` attribute expression**, so the render-prop hand-off `<DetailView schema={bound as DetailViewSchema} />` read as *"not the parent's document"* and `DetailView` was never enqueued.

⭐ The generalisation worth keeping: objectui#9344 peeled these type-only wrappers off a **read receiver** only, and **a lost HOP is strictly worse than a lost read, because the component leaves the census entirely.**

⭐ **Outcome 1 was established, not assumed**: a fresh `--list` on current `main` showed `detail` (raw) yielding 3 census rows and `detail-view` (wrapper) yielding **0** ⇒ PR #9702 did **not** incidentally fix it. That was the claim this seat most wanted tested, because the card's own reading predated #9702's rewrite of the same file.

⭐ **And the class was bounded**: the other 17 `elementDataSourceBlock` wrappers already hopped ⇒ **one instance, no sibling sweep owed.** ⛔ That is the difference between a fix and an open-ended hunt. Counters moved 46 → **49** reachable reads, all three new ones under `detail-view`.

Its transitive hop stops at the wrapper"*, a claim **this PR falsifies**. ⭐ Correct and worth making. ⚠️ But it went unmentioned in the hand-back: a named tripwire warrants a line even when the answer is "comments only", because silence on one costs the reviewer a hard stop.

`resolveComponent`'s `CallExpression` branch returns the first capitalised identifier argument and **discards the wrapper call's own body**, so a wrapper spelled `block(Inner)` that also renders document-carrying JSX around `Inner` would lose the outer half. ⛔ Correctly not filed — unreachable on this tree (the one such registration renders nothing around it), so no undeclared read is exposed.
